notes.title: 2.2.0 Olympian Trials Update - Available Now For Free!
notes.notes:
Monarch,

A deadly challenge awaits you this summer. Set forth and update your quest to the Olympian Trials, the new and free major content update available now for Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus.

The update forges together the formidable Challenge Islands of the base game with the visuals and ancient Greek myth-inspired armory and legends of the Call of Olympus expansion, letting you, brave Monarch, embark on a fresh new journey filled with challenges.

Discover the one reign, no heirs, single-attempt Challenge Islands in the mysterious Call of Olympus setting and visit - at your own peril - Dire Island, Plague Island, Skull Island, Lost Islands and Trade Routes. As a daring Monarch, wield the power of Medusa Shield, Hephaestus' Hammer, Bow of Artemis and Staff of Hermes, and overcome the toughest and most punishing of Greed-fighting trials in your own personal odyssey.

The Olympian Trials content update is free to all Steam owners of Kingdom Two Crowns and the Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus DLC.
[previewyoutube="ppnT_RSGR9Y;full"][/previewyoutube]

Olympian Trials patch notes:
Olympian Trials: Added Call of Olympus as a selectable biome in all Challenge Islands for all players who own the Call of Olympus DLC. You can now tackle the different challenges with strategic options hailing from the epic campaign, such as the godlike powers granted by divine artifacts, the Phalanx formation, as well as Fleet boats which can be built in the brand-new Shipyard.

Fixed a rare issue that could cause the in-game time to stop in any game mode, though more commonly encountered in the Plague Island challenge, caused by Greed spawning a long way from the kingdom walls at a specific timing.

Third time’s the charm: Your knights and their troops should now rotate outward correctly while defending from within the kingdom walls.

Your kingdom and citizens now correctly recognize the continuous threat of a portal under attack close to the the border.

The Donkey mount now poops 2 coins after eating.

Rebuilding broken walls now plays scaffolding SFX.

Call of Olympus: Hephaestus' forge now shows the correct visual sprite after quest completion, even after a save & load action.

Challenge Islands: Added an objective reminder to the loading screen whenever you play a Challenge Island.

Challenge Islands: Challenge selection audio stingers no longer cut off abruptly.

Plague Island: The player is no longer able to attack (or send Squires or Knights to attack) the cave portals, as they are invulnerable.

Fixed minor issues.

notes.title: 2.1.3 Knights & Zoom Fixes Patch
notes.notes:
Monarchs, 

As per our commitment to making sure your continued reign is as smooth and enjoyable as possible (excluding the attacks at night by you-know-who), we’re releasing the following update to your kingdom: 

 We took the knights through rigorous training to fix some errant behavior, as reported to us by our players. The training regimen included a refreshment of protocols regarding protecting their assigned archers, not abandoning a fight just because they take a hit or two, attacking portals and cave spawners, and retreating after the cave portal has been temporarily destroyed.  
 Fixed an issue in multiplayer that would cause the client’s coins to get stuck in mid-air when attempting to make a payment. 
 Fixed an issue in multiplayer that would cause currency to disappear from the client’s coin bag when sailing away or changing game modes. 
 Resolved a caching issue which could cause unintentional PlayFab account sharing. 
 After your feedback, we’ve decided to revert one of the QoL changes from patch 2.0: Player 2 dropping the coins from their coin bag on the ground when they disconnect. The coins will now stay in Player 2’s coin bag and become available when Player 2 reconnects, the same way it worked before the patch. However, gems and quest items will continue to be automatically transported to Player 1’s coin bag, to avoid soft lock scenarios. 
 Restored the larger range of zoom levels on supported resolutions and made sure art assets fit the screen properly.  
 The audio in the splash screens will now play correctly when you start a new campaign or Challenge Island in an ongoing session. 
 Players can once again see color changes while randomizing the Monarch’s appearance in the loading screen. 
 The Cursed Crown will now display correctly on the Trojan Monarch. 
 The bomb is now the top priority of your workers. Workers pushing the bomb now won’t abandon it so easily in pursuit of other jobs. Additionally, when called to the boat by the wharf bell, the workers that were originally pushing the bomb won’t block other workers from taking over their bomb duties. 
 Challenge Islands: Fixed an issue that could cause some players to experience a soft lock in multiplayer while sailing to the next island. 
 Call of Olympus: Coin slots should now be visible for all mount locations in local co-op. 
 Norse Lands: Archers in towers will no longer call dibs on shields in the Shield Shop, making them available for other units to pick up. 
 Norse Lands: Workers will now seek safety behind the Kingdom walls a bit faster. 
 Norse Lands: Improved visual effects on fire effects related to the Fire Tower. 
 Fixed minor visual and functional issues. 

This bugfix patch is part of our ongoing efforts to ensure the quality and smooth Monarch experience for Kingdom Two Crowns. Thank you for consistently sending your reports – we continue investigating them and developing further fixes.  

If you encounter an issue that has not been patched yet, please report it at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 This is the quickest way for us to have a look at what might be going wrong with your reign and help. 

Thank you for your patience, Monarchs, & long may you reign! 👑

notes.title: Patch notes Kingdom Two Crowns 2.1.2
notes.notes:
Monarchs,

This patch contains several bug fixes, improvements to memory performance and to networking including:


 Fixed the issue that would cause Hephaestus' hammer quest item to disappear from the level in multiplayer, blocking your progress. If your save file was affected, loading the save on the new patch will automatically complete the quest and grant you the reward.
 Fixed the issue that prevented the achievement Mediterranean Vacation from unlocking at the right time. Unfortunately, the achievement can not be unlocked retroactively on save files that were encountering this issue. To get it, the requirements must be met again in a fresh campaign.
 Optimized networking and reduced traffic to improve online co-op experience.
 Fixed several issues that could cause crashes to occur in specific gameplay scenarios.
 Fixed the issue that would sometimes cause ruler animations to break when starting a co-op session.
 Fixed the issue that would cause the client player’s movement to break while riding the Hippocampus.
 Fixed the issue where the boar re-spawning in wintertime would have the game consider the island as incomplete. If you give any lingering threats a good whack in this patch, it should do the trick and the island status will stay as "completed".
 Shield Walls in Norse Lands should now block Crushers correctly.
 Archers following a Squire or Knight should no longer be left outside the safety of the Kingdom walls at night.
 Archers on the Fleet boats should now attack Serpent weak points correctly.
 Farmers who have boarded a boat will no longer occupy farmlands.
 Fixed minor visual and audio issues.
 The zoom levels have been temporarily capped to prevent issues with environment graphics, while we are working on a bigger fix to preserve graphic integrity at more zoomed out levels for a future patch.

We'd like to take a moment and thank those of you who have tested the multiplayer public beta and confirmed the networking performance has improved. We will now end the public beta, so everyone in it will be automatically reverted back to the default branch which now, after this patch, has the same fixes.

We will continue to patch the game with more bugfixes as soon as possible. 

As before, we always communicate updates on our X, Facebook and Discord, so please make sure you follow them to stay on track with the latest news. If you encounter any further issues, please report them at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 as this is the quickest way for us to investigate and get back to you.

Thank you for your continuous support. 

/The Kingdom Team

notes.title: 🎮Dev Update - Multiplayer Fixes🎮
notes.notes:
Monarchs,

The team is now back from the holidays and our annual internal conference where we spent a lot of time planning. We will share more on that later, but for now we would like to focus on fixing and addressing some of the multiplayer issues identified in the game. We have implemented and tested a series of these fixes and would like to invite the community to participate in a public beta test for additional feedback. We deeply appreciate everyone's patience as we keep developing and implementing fixes to issues in the game.

Please note that this solution is still in testing - however, if it helps you, please do let us know in the comments. Some questions that could help would be - is it stable? Are there any unexpected disconnects? Is the connection reliable? Is there a lag? If it plays well for you, we'll be working on patching the game as soon as possible, so that you could start enjoying the multiplayer fully.

To access the beta, please follow these steps:

1. Go to your Steam Library
2. Right click on Kingdom Two Crowns -> Properties -> Betas
3. In the list of betas, please select "public-test - Multiplayer fixes to version 2.1.0 (Feb 25)"
4. Enjoy!

 Important - please make sure that your play partner is also playing the beta, and that you've made a backup of your saves before installing the update.

These are the fixes we've made in the public beta
With the goal of eliminating multiplayer issues and disconnects that players have reported, we have taken a good hard look at our networking code and found ways to reduce the overall network overhead. Our networking now uses less additional data to identify messages and state their purpose. We have also increased the timeout duration for connections meaning it will stick in there longer when you experience lag spikes or connectivity issues. We deployed some advanced optimization heuristics on our most common message types to also reduce the actual amount of data being sent. Along with the already optimized overhead, these two put together result in up to 40% less traffic. Finally we implemented some Steam specific optimizations to better utilize the Steam P2P networking API, minimizing external overhead and fixing a potential bottleneck.

/The Kingdom Team

notes.title: Patch notes Kingdom Two Crowns 2.1.0
notes.notes:
Monarchs,

Thank you for your patience as we've been working hard to identify, investigate and develop fixes for the issues you have reported. We have now published a major patch addressing the following bugs: 


 Fixed an issue that could cause the players to lose the required souls for the Hermes Quest in certain multiplayer situations.
 Fixed a bug that would cause the Cerberus head items to duplicate infinitely, filling up the coin pouch.
 Fixed an issue that could cause Persephone to disappear forever or escape to other islands.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from paying for the attack on the Serpent's weak point in split screen co-op.
 Fixed an issue that would cause a black screen when launching the game on Mac. If you are experiencing this issue after downloading the latest update, try restarting the game once OR exit and enter full screen once by using Command + Control + F (Big Sur and earlier) or Fn + F (Monterey or later), and the problem should be solved.
 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause mount abilities to be unusable until the player changes to another mount.
 Fixed a damage bug with Pikemen and Hoplites that would cause them to do less than intended damage against high health enemies. 
 Fixed several issues with Knight behavior when interacting with the Serpent, including situations where they would stop moving entirely.
 Fixed an issue that prevented islands in Call of Olympus from being registered as completed properly, causing decay to happen when it should not.
 Fixed several Norse Lands mounts' abilities not triggering pushback effect correctly.
 Fixed several issues with unit behavior when they interacted with Persephone’s cage, including Knights running past it.
 Workers will no longer run indefinitely to one side after their work gets destroyed.
 Breeders will no longer hit units standing behind walls.
 Floaters will no longer get stuck on walls.
 Fleet boats will now join a player bearing the banner even if there is no squad present.
 Squads will no longer jump off the ship when the player tries to sail away.
 Tweaked Greed portal behavior to not activate at inappropriate times.
 Lowered the spawn rate of Greed portal defense waves at lower difficulty settings.
 Fixed an issue that would cause the achievement “Master of the Sea” to trigger incorrectly.
 Fixed malfunctioning camera movement that would happen after destroying the caves in the Skull Island challenge.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from selecting their preferred ruler in the Lost Islands challenge.
 Fixed an issue that would cause the game to freeze if the player turns off the tutorial in Challenge Islands.
 Fixed the Cursed Crown placement on most Royal Wardrobe ruler skins.
 Fixed an issue that would show incorrect island completion values in the save slots.
 Fixed an issue that would show incorrect gem and portal values on the map.
 Fixed some text strings flowing outside of the visible area during split screen co-op.
 Addressed several visual issues with sprites, VFX, and UI.
 Addressed several visual and sync issues in multiplayer.

With this patch we have resolved a wide number of issues that you have identified and we are still investigating a few more. We're committed to making Kingdom a high quality experience, and are therefore continuously at work on improving it. We always communicate updates on our X, Facebook and Discord, so please make sure you follow them not to miss any. If you encounter any further issues, please report them at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 as this is the quickest way for us to have a look and get back to you. 

Thank you for your continuous support. It is thanks to your love for Kingdom and the support desk tickets you created that even a small team like ours has a chance to tackle the trickiest of bugs.

/The Kingdom Team

notes.notes:
With the release of Call of Olympus NEXT WEEK (excitement!) we’re also giving the Kingdom Two Crowns base game a 2.0 update. There's loads of quality-of-life updates, and those will be free for everyone who owns Kingdom Two Crowns, regardless of whether you purchase Call of Olympus or not. Some of the improvements we’ve already talked about (like more save slots and the option to disable the tutorial ghost!) but for this blog post we're inviting you to dive a little deeper into the details with one of our programmers, Danijel. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/839894350cdffeb132f51c97b0e2db43fe2767f4.jpg
With the 2.0 update of Kingdom Two Crowns we have re-envisioned the visual representation of the game. Can you spot all the details?

Hi, I’m Danijel. Let me introduce you to Kingdom Two Crowns 2.0!
There are many improvements coming to KTC with the 2.0 update (see a longer list further down below) but here are some of my favorites!

Archers, knights and pikemen will no longer guard a side of your kingdom, if it is completely safe! Instead, they will rush to the other side and help where it is still needed. But don't worry, a few archers will still stay behind and hunt so you don't lose your income. 
Talking of smarter units, the archers also realized they don't have infinite range and it does not help anyone, if they occupy towers deep within the kingdom. You can now build towers close to your keep without worrying that the archers will take up permanent residence inside, and be unavailable when you need them once the kingdom is expanded. As walls are built and torn down, archers will now only occupy the towers within reasonable distance from the walls. 
If you found it hard to guess how much health a beach portal has remaining, you were not alone. Unlike forest portals which slowly crumble to let you know, beach portals were impossible to read. But no more! They have now grown little pustules which pop as they take damage, and once all pustules are gone the portal falls. 
If you enjoy playing multiplayer and admire the nature in Kingdom, you may appreciate this one: we greatly improved the multiplayer syncing of both the kinds of trees and bushes, as well as foliage colors and states of trees and bushes as they change colors, lose and regrow leaves with the change of seasons. So, you and your play partner can enjoy the same view when standing next to each other in multiplayer. 
We also fixed some annoyances, for example we now apply your saved sound settings during the boot-up sequence. So, if you are used to playing Kingdom with low volume, you don't get blasted by the sound. 
Ninjas in Shogun were too fond of their hiding spots and could hide in their old spot within your walls where encountering the Greed is unlikely. Or they would hide in plain sight once their favourite bamboo tree was cut down. This is no longer the case. 
You can now interact with a mount that walks towards a stable. You don’t need to wait for it to arrive there anymore! 
Islands where you completely eradicated the Greed no longer decay. Yay! 
If archers retreating from a fallen wall pass by an empty tower, they will take shelter and shoot the Greed there. 

Some funny bugs that we fixed: 

The rabbits in O&B no longer play chicken sounds for P2 while in multiplayer. 
The rider on the loading screen now gallops with the steed when loading is complete. 
You can no longer change the difficulty while looking at the peaceful difficulty confirmation.  
P2 can now see the difficulty of the game they joined in multiplayer, instead of labeling everything normal.
In multiplayer, P2 will now also hear the wonderful flute the Shogun merchant plays when dropping coins. 
While hunting or defending, if an archer shoots the rope holding a Monarch cage in Deadlands without having the player pay for it, it is now accounted for! Lucky shot indeed. 

This and much more will be available on October 8th for all of our players. Thanks, Danijel, for letting us peek behind the curtain to see what you and the rest of the team has been up to! 

The Kingdom Two Crowns 2.0 patch notes in detail:

The new save slot system lets you create up to 10 save slots. Your existing save files will be automatically converted to the new system and keep your progress intact.  
The new campaign select flow will give you a better overview when you select your preferred difficulty mode and ruler. It will also showcase the new ruler skins available through the Royal Wardrobe DLC’s, also launching alongside this patch! 
Added an option to disable the tutorial ghost. The ghost is also a bit less intrusive while it is enabled. However, the Oracle will still show up for certain events in Call of Olympus even with the tutorial ghost disabled, as the Oracle is a part of the story!  
Improved the level generation of the game. Walls, farms, and towers are now placed more evenly and with higher priority around the levels. Trees and bushes will overlap less with other structures. Shop placement has also been worked on, and should result in more reliable shop generation and less overlapping structures at the edge of your Kingdom. 
The winter season has been rebalanced to match your chosen difficulty level, making easier modes easier and (you guessed it) harder modes harder. Critters will spawn occasionally from the bushes, the number of berry bushes will depend on the difficulty, and the boar will spawn further from your Kingdom walls.  
Greed portals will be more reactive to your presence, and their defense waves will scale with the length of the current campaign. 
The offensive units have gone through mandatory training for defending your Kingdom where there is actual danger. This means that if one side of the level is clear of portals and threats, all units will focus on defending the side of your Kingdom that is still endangered. 
Had a chat with the worker units about their downtime behavior - they will now spread out more evenly throughout your Kingdom to await your next command!  
When citizens drop coins, they throw them in your movement direction instead of just dropping them on the ground. 
All mounts will now clearly show when they have finished feeding and regained their stamina sparkles. 
The bear mount has gotten an overhaul in all biomes where it can be found. We’ve lowered the cost and made improvements to its movement and stamina, and tweaked its attacks. It now regains a small bit of stamina whenever it hits another animal.  
Did a balance pass on the difficulty modes - harder modes now have a higher difficulty. Good luck!  
Improved VFX and lighting systems, which will improve both the visual look and the performance of the game. 
Added an overview of the game’s control scheme in the options menu 
And LOTS more! 

A Wardrobe fit for a Monarch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/4a35b1f9c4b7fcac56b94268429616c04fc2210a.gif
We’ve created a new way to support the future development of Kingdom and we’re calling this The Royal Wardrobe – it is a new option in Kingdom Two Crowns that offers new looks for your Monarch. We’ve put together a total of six new skins, inspired by both the original Medieval setting and the new ancient Greece-themed setting. You can however use them in all settings, except for Dead Lands (since in that one the Monarchs are named characters!). The skins are purely cosmetic with no extra in-game functionality. Rather it’s an additional means for players to support the future development of Kingdom. We did allow ourselves to be a bit sillier with this one than we usually are, especially with the Trojan Monarch. We hope you’ll like this very genuine and real Monarch as much as we do!

Features

 Added difficulty modes to Kingdom Two Crowns! You can now conquer your Kingdom in one of the following difficulty modes: Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard, and Cursed. The different modes will adjust the spawn rate of the Greed to your preference.
 Norse Lands: There is something strange ab--ᛟᚢᛏ ᚦᛖ ᛊᛏᚨᚠᚠ ᚷᚱᚨᚾᛏᛖᛞ ᛒᛁ ᚦᛖ ᛚᛟᚲᛁ ᛊᚺᚱᛁᚾᛖ… ᚨᛊ ᛁᛟᚢ ᛈᛖᛖᚱ ᛁᚾᛏᛟ ᚦᛖ ᛊᛏᚨᚠᚠ ᛁᛟᚢ ᚲᚨᚾ ᚨᛚᛗᛟᛊᛏ ᚺᛖᚨᚱ ᚦᛖ ᚷᛟᛞ ᛟᚠ ᛗᛁᛊᚲᚺᛁᛖᚠ. ᛁᛊ ᚺᛖ… ᚲᚺᚢᚲᚲᛚᛁᛜ?

 Small improvements to Knights and their Archers in combat.

Multiplayer

Norse Lands balance changes

 Norse Lands Bankers now have extended working hours.
 The tree in the Norse Lands Vagrant Camp has sadly died and been cut down.
 Monarchs can now pay for Shield Walls during the day, allowing for preparation for the night's attack.

 Builders will leave their catapult to repair walls in the mornings.
 Breeders now throw catapult stones back less often.

 Fixed an issue that caused players with the system language set to Thai or Arabic to experience infinite saving or game freeze at campaign start. 
 More towers can now be built on each island, so the “I HAVE THE TOWER!” achievement should be easier to unlock. In order to access the new towers, you must start a new island or game.

 Fixed an issue that would cause the game to soft-lock when players paid for the Wall Horn in co-op.

 Hermits should no longer jump off your mount at night if the Monarch is heading towards home.

 Fixed a visual bug that caused the wrong tower model to spawn in Dead Lands.
 Fixed a visual bug that caused the Forge to spawn below ground in Shogun.
 Fixed a bug where Norse Lands Berserkers would Rage continuously instead of attacking. 
 Fixed the monarch animation when riding the Sleipnir mount.
 Additional minor bug fixes and tweaks.


Onward and safe travels! 👑

Dear monarchs! Here’s what’s new in patch 1.1.12:

New biome - Norse Lands: Our first premium DLC is set in a domain inspired by Norse Viking culture 1000 C.E. Norse Lands is a full new campaign that expands the world of Kingdom Two Crowns with a unique setting to build, defend, explore, and conquer. In Norse Lands, players can look forward to unleashing abilities drawn upon from Norse gods, commanding mighty units, building Viking-inspired armaments, solving challenging puzzles, and facing a new enemy Greed.

Citizen house: Do you ever find yourself cutting down trees around vagrant camps and then instantly regretting the choices you’ve made? No need to worry! This patch allows you to build citizen houses from the ruins of a vagrant camp. There, you can always recruit new citizens to defend your Kingdom at an increased price.

Unit behavior changes

Units will no longer attack portals unless ordered to do so.
The Merchant will now payout at any time of day, but only accept payment to leave the Kingdom if it is safe.
The Banker will now payout multiple times a day, so long as the player needs coins and the banker has coins.
Archers will now only occupy the towers close to the border of your Kingdom or outside of your Kingdom. Additionally, they will no longer leave the safety of the Kingdom at night to try and enter towers.
Speaking of Archers in towers: they now shoot further than archers on the ground, and they will hunt from the tower during the day.
Up to eight Pikemen can now defend each border of your Kingdom.
Vagrants will now turn into Peasants as soon as they finish eating bread. Rulers can still intercept them with coins to save on bread bills.
Armored Greedlings are now stronger and tougher to defeat.
Breeders now arrive on time with the rest of the wave, and retreat at dawn instead of dying.

Blood Moon & Retaliation wave changes

Fixed an issue where Blood Moons would clear incorrectly, leaving your Kingdom vulnerable and without defenses at the end of the wave.
Blood Moons and recovery days are now consistent throughout the game, getting more frequent the longer the game lasts. We also added a minor Blood Moon at the end of the first spring, so you’ll get used to it sooner ;)
Daybreak will no longer end the onslaught from Blood Moons and Retaliation waves. Your Kingdom won’t be safe until every Greed has been defeated!
Fixed lack of cooldown days after Blood Moons in the Dead Lands biome.
Retaliation waves are not as punishing as fast, to allow Rulers more portal destruction action before being accidentally overwhelmed.
Portal defense waves grow smoothly over time and become more difficult sooner. You'll need Knights to take portals in the late game because your Squires will die. That’s a promise!

notes.title: The Conquest Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/1a3662ddb8072da8e695a08c791cb1316469f8b8.png

Monarchs! The free Conquest Update arrives Tuesday, Nov 16th, bringing with it a host of updates and improvements to all the settings of Kingdom Two Crowns (original, Shogun, and Dead Lands). Once installed, all changes will be in effect from both new games and existing saves. Here are some highlights to get you excited for and thinking about your next reign.

Firstly, the Citizen House. This new structure provides a solution for recruiting new citizens after clearing out a vagrant camp. Maybe you want to make a clean-looking kingdom. Perhaps you accidentally cleared around your last camp. Whatever the reason, vagrant camp ruins can now be rebuilt into a Citizen House. Once constructed, it will provide a ready source of new citizens, albeit at a higher cost.

Next, Archers! We told them to stop wandering out to towers at night. While we were at it, we encouraged them not to man towers that were really far from the borders either. They'll now abandon towers that end up too deep in your Kingdom and look for something useful to do. We kindly instructed them how to take advantage of their height to shoot farther, and they'll also hunt from their tower during the daytime now, making better use of their spare time. Don't get too overconfident in their improvements, as an all-archer army might not stand up as well as it used to.

Lastly, balance changes. Catapults and ballista towers have improved accuracy and damage (very satisfying in action). We refined the way Blood Moon and Retaliation waves work. They'll no longer clear incorrectly, leaving your Kingdom defenceless and vulnerable. Enemy waves will cycle between Blood Moons and recovery waves more consistently; expect Blood Moons to get more frequent as the game goes on. Greed now defend Portals with more fervour as well, and you can expect them to ramp up their response as you get further into the game: you're going to be needing those trusty knights!

Those are just a few gameplay highlights that we believe will vastly improve your experience. On top of gameplay changes, we have tech updates and upgrades. Let's just say players with wide and ultrawide monitors will get an improved overview of their Kingdom. Monarchs, prepare to reign over your best Kingdom ever.

Until next time, safe travels.

notes.title: Norse Lands and Conquest Update Available November 16
notes.notes:
Norse Lands

Norse Lands comes as a big moment for us. Living and working in Sweden the Scandinavian spirit runs strong. Its cultural heritage for survival and exploration felt like such a natural fit as we continued to explore new settings and cultures for the game. Everything finally aligned and we set about making a complete Viking experience drawn from those influences that keeps the core of what makes Kingdom fun.

The result is Norse Lands, a new full campaign inspired by the Viking culture of 1000 C.E.. Players can look forward to leading a strong people where everyone takes up arms to join the fight, unleash powers drawn from the legends of Norse gods, command mighty units, build Viking-inspired armaments, solve challenging puzzles, and face a new enemy type that has joined the Greed.

[previewyoutube=W9iuUJF08xc;full][/previewyoutube]

Conquest Update

During the development of Norse Lands we went through all your feedback and added it to our own wishlist for improvements to make in the game. This work resulted in a number of welcome changes and improvements that we wanted for all the settings in Kingdom Two Crowns. We’re calling it the Conquest update. It is a free update available to everyone with the game at the same time that Norse Lands comes out. 

Here are some things to look forward to. There is the new Citizen House that can be built on the ruins of a vagrant camp that gives you a ready supply of new citizens - at a cost of coin. The townspeople received coaching to address some of their annoying habits. As a result, they are now better at their jobs. Battle also sees refinements, including the pace of enemy waves, unit balance, decay, and this is just to name a few. Check out developer blog posts if you are interested in more details about the gameplay updates. The complete patch notes will be available shortly on the forums so keep an eye out for those as well.

Get ready, Monarch, your best Kingdom yet awaits.

notes.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Dear Monarchs!

We’d like to thank everyone that eagerly built their kingdoms spanning across many lands, each filled with secrets to be discovered. As your kingdoms expanded for each passing day, the seasons were passing as well. Eventually winter comes, which can be very harsh if your coffers are empty, making you hunker down behind safety of the walls as the Greed descend upon your Kingdom to pillage during the night. In the previous game Kingdom: New Lands, the intention was to escape the land with winter being the end state. In Kingdom Two Crowns however you must persevere through winter to spring and end the Greed. However, there is good news, the citizens have discovered new ways to be more active during winter allowing for more options to continue your plight against the Greed. Read below for more details:


 Hunting during winter: While the smaller animals go into winter hibernation, there’s other animals that suddenly appear as the snow starts falling on the ground. But beware that you must first find this menacing animal deep in the forest, and once confronted it’s much tougher than the regular small game that roamed outside the walls of your kingdom during spring, summer and autumn.

https://i.imgur.com/hP7X8aU.gif

 Foraging during winter: Since the farms can’t harvest during winter, the Farmers have discovered foraging to bring in a bit of extra income. It’s not much but every bit helps.

https://i.imgur.com/OrQTcTY.gif

 Shinobi: Who says being a stealth warrior at night is all we’re good for?! During long nights of waiting in ambush the Shinobi came up with a brilliant way to pass time during the day instead of just sleeping.

https://i.imgur.com/vp1hJBh.gif

 Introducing the Gem Chest: Those gems sure are a heavy burden to carry around while you explore for valuable upgrades to use gems on. Now you can lighten your purse and store the gems in a stone chest. This appears by the Wharf once you’ve upgraded your Kingdom to a Stone Castle. Storing gems is a costly business, so it won’t be free for the Monarch to offload those precious gems.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32967186/98f9dc94609f16643dbfef7acfa83f8d34f5f1db.png

 Other updates: In addition to the above there’s also fixes and changes such as an upgrade to the Stable to make switch Steeds more affordable, improving appearance of shops on the edge of your kingdom walls as you expand, and optimisation of save data compression, to mention a few. We have also included Brazilian-Portuguese as a language option and improved the Russian text.


SteamOS (Linux)
Kingdom Two Crowns is coming soon to Linux. For eager monarchs, there’s a beta branch that can be tested on Steam. Please provide us with feedback and reports bugs by using this form.

What holds the future for Kingdom Two Crowns?
In the immediate future there will be more quality of life updates like this Winter update. We promised new locations similar to the Japanese setting in Shogun. These will be coming later down the road and all we can say is that it will be worth the wait! But before venturing into completely new lands, there will be an update with Challenge Islands. These offer an alternative experience to the campaign with a tougher roguelike gameplay and custom rules. More on that later. Now venture forth and overthrow the Greed!

notes.title: Updates Incoming in QoL Update #1
notes.notes:
X-post from the Community Forums; to participate in the original discussion, see the original thread here.

Hi Monarchs!

We wanted to share some of the things we collected from your feedback so far that we will try our best to get in the first big update. This is planned to release early next year (2019). Even if some don't make the first Update we will get them in at some point. We have two big free content updates planned for 2019 and one more big QoL in 2019.

From your feedback

 Improve Winter experience
 Improve Hermit behavior
 Improve Ninja's value
 Make switching Steeds less costly
 Increase Pikemen health i.e. how many successful attacks they can perform before spear breaks)
 Add a way to recover lost gems
 Improve initiating Coop splitscreen experience
 Improve outer wall units shop location i.e. shops move outward with expansion of walls.


We will continue to add to this list, once we've reached our bandwidth we'll add more to the next big update.

Already in Planning and very likely to make it into the QoL #01 Update

 Introduce the Challenge Islands
 Add SteamOS (Linux) Support
 Add Original Ruler DLC for all owners of Kingdom: Classic and Kingdom: New Lands
 Fix Knights/Samurai going on the boat instead of attacking the portal.


FYI - critical issues like corrupted saves will be treated as high priority and planned to be patched as quickly as possible.
